learning_outcomes.text: Defines heat transfer types and mechanisms.
Analyzes heat transfer in various geometric parts.
Analyzes heat transfer in extended surfaces.
Analyzes heat transfer when there is heat generation.
Analyzes heat conduction using numerical methods.

syllabus_topics: Definitions, physical principles and heat transfer relations
Basic relations of heat transfer by conduction, convection and radiation
Heat conduction equation, systems with heat generation (heat source)
Variable heat conduction coefficient and heat conduction in plane walls
Heat conduction in multi-layered or combined plane walls
Thermal contact resistance and heat conduction in radial systems
Heat transfer in extended surfaces (fins), Time-Dependent Heat Transfer
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on 50% in-term success and 50% final exam. In-term success is composed of Quiz 1 (15%), Quiz 2 (15%), and Midterm Exam 1 (70%).
